<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>Frequency Divider implementing fractional division by 3.5x using double edge clocking technique</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input Clock Signal</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active Low Reset Signal</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractional Divided Clock Output</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIV_NUM" value="7">Number of divisions for fractional division</parameter>
        <parameter id="HALF_CLK_PERIODE" value="3">Half of the clock periode</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRC_CLK_PERIODE" value="7">Source clock periode</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="count" width_description="[3:0]">Count variable for fractional division</reg>
        <reg id="div_clk" width_description="[1:0]">Divided clock signal</reg>
        <wire id="src_clk_periode">Source clock periode</wire>
        <assign src_clk_periode = DIV_NUM + HALF_CLK_PERIODE;
        </assign>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                count <= 0;
            end else begin
                if(count == SRC_CLK_PERIODE - 1) begin
                    count <= 0;
                end else begin
                    count <= count + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                div_clk[0] <= 0;
            end else begin
                if(count >= HALF_CLK_PERIODE && count < DIV_NUM) begin
                    div_clk[0] <= ~div_clk[0];
                end
            end
        end
        
        <always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                div_clk[1] <= 0;
            end else begin
                if(count >= HALF_CLK_PERIODE && count < DIV_NUM) begin
                    div_clk[1] <= ~div_clk[1];
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Double edge clocking technique used to implement fractional division by 3.5x</implementation>
    <task>
        <id>reset_task</id>
        <description>Resets the module's internal states.</description>
        <sequence>
            <statement>count <= 0;</statement>
            <statement>div_clk <= 0;</statement>
        </sequence>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>divide_by_half_clk_period_task</id>
        <description>Divides the input clock by half its period.</description>
        <sequence>
            <if condition="count >= HALF_CLK_PERIODE && count < DIV_NUM">
                <then>
                    <statement>div_clk <= ~div_clk;</statement>
                </then>
            </if>
        </sequence>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>advance_div_clock_task</id>
        <description>Advances the divided clock by half its period.</description>
        <sequence>
            <if condition="count >= HALF_CLK_PERIODE && count < DIV_NUM">
                <then>
                    <statement>div_clk <= ~div_clk;</statement>
                </then>
            </if>
        </sequence>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>phase_shift_div_clock_task</id>
        <description>Phases shifts the divided clock by half its period.</description>
        <sequence>
            <if condition="count >= HALF_CLK_PERIODE && count < DIV_NUM">
                <then>
                    <statement>div_clk <= ~div_clk;</statement>
                </then>
            </if>
        </sequence>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>generate_output_clk_task</id>
        <description>Generates the fractional divided clock output by combining the divided clocks.</description>
        <sequence>
            <statement>clk_div <= |div_clk;</statement>
        </sequence>
    </task>
</module>
